title: Let a coordinator transfer a live claim from an unavailable holder session, with an audited reason
outcome: Let a coordinator transfer a live claim from an unavailable holder session, with an audited reason
acceptance: A project-bound coordinator session can move a live claim held by another session to a named successor session (or release it) before it lapses, with a required reason; the event is immutable, attributed to the acting session and records the prior holder, successor and reason

The prior holder's claim is fenced at once: any later gate, note-as-holder, done, handoff or renew from it is refused with a reason naming the transfer; nothing it did before the transfer is lost or rewritten
The successor receives the claim with the existing recovery semantics (contribution and waiver accounting as for --recover), and show/next display the transfer
Behaviour tests cover: transfer by a coordinator, refusal for a session without that standing, the old holder's refused writes, and the successor's ordinary work and done
